title: Flavor Profile of 4-Isothiocyanato-1-butene in Microwave Rapeseed Oil and Its Anti-Inflammatory Properties In Vitro.
authors: Xiang, Xia; Liu, Huihui; Zheng, Chang; Jiang, Nanjie; Huang, Fenghong; Zhou, Qi
journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文研究菜籽油中4-BITC的风味与抗炎机制，涉及分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: 4-Isothiocyanato-1-butene (4-BITC) is a crucial plant isothiocyanate; however, its flavor profile in microwave rapeseed oil and its anti-inflammatory properties have not been elucidated in detail. Therefore, in this study, the distribution of 4-BITC in 45 rapeseed oils was quantitated using selected ion monitoring, with concentrations ranging from 0.29 to 8.63 mg/kg. The odor activity values ranged from 4 to 123. In a lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced RAW264.7 cell model, 4-BITC exerted dose-dependent anti-inflammatory effects, which resulted in remarkable differences in 20 lipid mediators between the LPS and 4-BITC groups. Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes analysis revealed that 4-BITC downregulated proinflammatory oxylipins by modulating the CYP, LOX, and COX pathways, thereby preventing arachidonic acid metabolism disorders. Molecular docking further confirmed that 4-BITC inhibited the PI3K/Akt/NF-kappaB signaling cascade to alleviate inflammation.
abstract_zh: 4-异硫氰酸基-1-丁烯（4-BITC）是一种重要的植物异硫氰酸酯；然而，其在微波菜籽油中的风味特征及其抗炎特性尚未被详细阐明。因此，本研究采用选择离子监测对45种菜籽油中4-BITC的分布进行了定量分析，其浓度范围为0.29至8.63 mg/kg。气味活性值范围为4至123。在脂多糖（LPS）诱导的RAW264.7细胞模型中，4-BITC表现出剂量依赖性的抗炎作用，导致LPS组与4-BITC组之间20种脂质介质存在显著差异。京都基因与基因组百科全书分析显示，4-BITC通过调节CYP、LOX和COX通路下调促炎性氧化脂质，从而预防花生四烯酸代谢紊乱。分子对接进一步证实，4-BITC抑制PI3K/Akt/NF-kappaB信号级联以缓解炎症。
